第15章司晨逐日
洪四海手下劲力一吐，毕通天就此气绝。
只留下洪四海仰天咆哮，声音如滚滚雷霆，震动整个临海城。他们头顶上空的白云都被震散了，迅速退去数十里，露出一方广阔的天际。
“哈哈哈哈！”
“我们十二元辰送的礼物，不知洪盟主您还满意吗？”一声大笑，紧跟着一个高亢的声音，仿佛捏着嗓子，扯着喉咙在说话。
声音沙哑的常常被叫做公鸭嗓，乘雾神君伪装的声音如同毒蛇吐信，可以叫蛇腔，而这个声音可以说特征非常明显，应该叫公鸡嗓才对。
另外一个沉闷声音也由远及近：“还有你们四个废物……”
沙家四兄弟原本就已经接近瘫软，这时候却像是见了鬼一般，甚至见了鬼都没有那么夸张，他们面露极度惊恐之色，原本已经瘫软到了地上，现在又开始挣扎了起来。可这时候，他们脚下的土地一陷，整个人突然被拖入了地下。
一直到被埋在胸口……
“尔敢！”洪四海一声怒吼，就要顿足踏向地面。
一个金色的人影飞快从天空掠过，他披着一条金色披风，快如闪过的燕子，手中似乎扣住了什么，在半空中连连发出橘黄色，近乎指头大小的焰火。
洪四海脸色大变，一拳击打在虚空中，拳劲涌出覆盖了他身前十丈。
那些橘金色焰火被拳劲一覆，便凌空爆炸，威力之大，就是有一具铁人，也该被粉身碎骨了。
这时候洪四海怀里的毕通天遗体突然抽搐，胸膛向上挺，尸体对着洪四海吐出同样的一颗橘金色焰火，洪四海想也不想，撤拳回身，反手用拳握住那一点焰火。
“洪老堂主不可！”在场的几位高人纷纷惊呼道。
这时候时间早已经来不及了！
本该将毕通天遗体炸碎的强大爆炸被他生生用手覆灭……未曾波及那脆弱的尸体一分一毫。
可洪四海纵然武功惊人，身体横练也到了一个绝顶的程度，但硬生生吃下这一记，依旧让他右拳受到了重创，不住颤抖，手上皮开肉绽。“不要管我……去救沙家四兄弟。”这时候大家才有心思去看那沙家的四个兄弟。
他们半截身体埋在土里面，大家刚刚全部心神都被洪四海的安危吸引。
此时再去看，他们都瘫软在地上，有进气没出气了！

空明神僧告了一身罪，以巧劲将他们从土中提起，刚刚用力空明神僧就感觉不对……手中太轻了！这时候，被拔出来的沙家四兄弟都只剩下了半截。看着血流如注，空荡荡的下半身，就像是空明神僧将他们拔断了一般！
在场惊叫混合成一片！
钱晨也神色凝重，十二元辰果然不愧是江湖有史以来最恶毒，最狠辣，最可怕，最残忍，最大胆的一伙强盗……而这个世界的神兵之威力，更是超乎他的预料。
那金衣人的披风便是他的神兵，具有辅助飞遁，以及凝聚雷火之能。
此世神兵在这些突破感应，能肉身接引天地元气的武道宗师加持之下，性命交修，发挥出来的威力远远超乎钱晨的预料，寻常通法修士……还真不是这些人的对手。武道不已性命为先，一意杀伐，据说出自上古巫教，如今看来，果然杀伐之力惊人。

Chapter 15 Si Chen chases the day
Hong Sihai's men breathed out all their strength, and Bi Tongtian died.
Only Hong Sihai was left roaring up to the sky, his voice like rolling thunder, shaking the entire Linhai City. The white clouds above their heads were shaken away and quickly receded for dozens of miles, revealing a vast sky.
"Hahahaha!"
"I wonder if you are satisfied with the gift from our Twelfth Yuanchen, Alliance Leader Hong?" A loud laugh followed by a high-pitched voice, as if he was speaking with his throat pinched.
A hoarse voice is often called a drake's voice. The disguised voice of Chengwu Shenjun is like a poisonous snake spitting messages, which can be called a snake's voice. This voice can be said to have very obvious characteristics and should be called a rooster's voice.
Another dull voice also came from far away: "There are four of you losers..."
The four brothers of the Sha family were already close to being paralyzed, but now they seemed to have seen a ghost. Even seeing a ghost was not that exaggerated. They looked extremely frightened. They had already collapsed to the ground, but now they began to struggle again. But at this time, the ground beneath their feet sank, and their whole bodies were suddenly dragged underground.
Until it is buried in the chest...
"How dare you!" Hong Sihai roared angrily, stamping his feet to the ground.
A golden figure flew across the sky quickly. He was wearing a golden cloak. He was as fast as a swallow that flashed by. Something seemed to be held in his hand, and orange-yellow fireworks that were almost the size of a finger were emitted in mid-air.
Hong Sihai's expression changed drastically, and he punched the air with a punch. The force of the punch surged out and covered ten feet in front of him.
Those orange-gold fireworks exploded in the air as soon as the force of the fist hit them. They were so powerful that even an iron man would have been shattered to pieces.
At this time, Bi Tongtian's body in Hong Sihai's arms suddenly twitched, his chest pushed upwards, and the body spit out the same orange-gold firework at Hong Sihai. Without thinking, Hong Sihai withdrew his fist and turned around, holding the little firework with his backhand.
"Old Hall Master Hong, no!" Several experts present exclaimed.
By this time it’s already too late!
The powerful explosion that was supposed to blow Bi Tongtian's body into pieces was destroyed by his own hands... without even affecting the fragile body.
But even though Hong Sihai's martial arts skills were astonishing and his body had reached an extremely advanced level, taking this blow by force still caused severe damage to his right fist, causing him to tremble constantly and the skin on his hand was torn. "Leave me alone...go save the four brothers of the Sha family." Only then did everyone have the intention to see the four brothers of the Sha family.
Half of their bodies were buried in the soil, and everyone was focused on Hong Sihai's safety.
When I looked at them again at this time, they were all slumped on the ground, with air coming in but not coming out!
The monk Kongming confessed his crime and lifted them up from the earth with skillful strength. As soon as he exerted his force, the monk Kongming felt something was wrong... his hand was too light! At this time, only half of the four Sha family brothers were left. Seeing the blood flowing profusely and the empty lower body, it was as if Kongming Divine Monk had cut them off!
The crowd screamed in surprise!
Qian Chen also looked solemn. Twelve Yuanchen was indeed the most vicious, ruthless, terrifying, cruel, and bold group of bandits in the history of Jianghu... And the power of the magic weapons in this world was beyond his expectation.
The cloak of the man in golden clothes is his magic weapon, which has the ability to assist flight and condense thunder and fire.
Under the blessing of these martial arts masters who can physically absorb the vitality of heaven and earth, the divine weapons of this world have cultivated their lives, and the power they exerted far exceeded Qian Chen's expectations. Ordinary magic cultivators... are really no match for these people. Martial arts puts life first and is determined to kill. It is said that it comes from the ancient witchcraft. Now it seems that the killing power is astonishing.
